Commercial Lease Report May 25-29, 2026
TUCSON, AZ (June 1, 2026) — Commercial lease activity reported for the week of May 25–29, 2026, totaled 32,719 square feet, including 23,243 square feet of office/medical office space, 7,072 square feet of industrial space, and 2,404 square feet of retail space.
The largest new lease was MBI Occupational Healthcare Tucson, LLC for 9,936 square feet at Butterfield Technology Center, represented by Brandon Clarke with Cresa for the tenant and Isaac Figueroa, CCIM, SIOR, with Larsen Baker for the landlord. The largest renewal was Soundthinking, Inc., for 6,400 square feet at The Transamerica Building, represented by Lucia Hedke of Jones Lang LaSalle Brokerage, Inc., for the tenant, and Thomas J. Nieman of Cushman & Wakefield | PICOR, for the landlord.
The following leases were reported to the Real Estate Daily News for the week of May 25–29, 2026.
NEW LEASES
OFFICE/MEDICAL OFFICE – 4775 S. BUTTERFIELD DR., TUCSON, AZ 85714, SOUTH SUBMARKET
MBI Occupational Healthcare Tucson, LLC leased 9,936 square feet at Butterfield Technology Center, 4775 S. Butterfield Dr., Suite 149 D, in Tucson, from Larsen Baker. Isaac Figueroa, CCIM, SIOR, with Larsen Baker represented the landlord, and Brandon Clarke with Cresa represented the tenant.
INDUSTRIAL – 1037 E. MILES ST., TUCSON, AZ 85719, CENTRAL SUBMARKET
Speedway Junk Removal LLC leased 2,650 square feet of office/warehouse space at 1037 E. Miles St. in Tucson from Rich Rodgers Central Inc. Max Fisher with BRD Realty handled this transaction.
OFFICE – 190 W. CONTINENTAL RD., GREEN VALLEY, AZ 85622, EXTENDED SOUTH
TALAMAZKA LLC leased 2,514 square feet of office space at Continental Plaza – Green Valley, 190 W. Continental Rd., Suite 202, in Green Valley, from Continental Green Valley Associates, LLC. Rob Tomlinson, Principal, Retail Specialist, and Ryan McGregor, Office Specialist, with Cushman & Wakefield | PICOR represented the landlord.
OFFICE – 3275 W. INA RD., TUCSON, AZ 85741, NORTHWEST SUBMARKET
Chaparral Group, Inc., dba Home Care Assistance of Tucson, leased 1,657 square feet of office space at Ina Corporate Center, 3275 W. Ina Rd., Suite 117, in Tucson, from CALDOR Investments of Arizona, LLC. Thomas J. Nieman, Principal, Office Specialist with Cushman & Wakefield | PICOR, represented the landlord. Michael Coretz with Commercial Real Estate Group of Tucson LLC represented the tenant.
OFFICE – 3275 W. INA RD., TUCSON, AZ 85741, NORTHWEST SUBMARKET
Rincon Ventures, Inc. leased 1,507 square feet of office space at Ina Corporate Center, 3275 W. Ina Rd., Suite 145, in Tucson, from CALDOR Investments of Arizona, LLC. Thomas J. Nieman, Principal, Office Specialist with Cushman & Wakefield | PICOR, represented the landlord.
OFFICE – 2933 N. CAMPBELL AVE., TUCSON, AZ 85719, CENTRAL SUBMARKET
Clear View Solutions, Inc. leased 1,229 square feet at 2933 N. Campbell Ave., Campbell Casitas, in Tucson, from Hanarm Building, LLC. Cameron Casey of Oxford Realty Advisors represented the tenant, and Robert Nolan of Oxford Realty Advisors represented the landlord.
RETAIL – 6970 E. 22ND ST., TUCSON, AZ 85710, EAST SUBMARKET
Zenith Vape leased 1,204 square feet of retail space at Eastpoint Marketplace, 6970 E. 22nd St., Suite 118, in Tucson, from Tucson Newcrest, LLC. Dave Hammack and Rob Tomlinson, Principals, Retail Specialists with Cushman & Wakefield | PICOR, represented the landlord.
RENEWALS
OFFICE – 177 N. CHURCH AVE., TUCSON, AZ 85701, CENTRAL SUBMARKET
Soundthinking, Inc. renewed its lease with TA Building Corporation for 6,400 square feet of office space at The Transamerica Building, 177 N. Church Ave., Suite 301, in Tucson. Thomas J. Nieman, Principal, Office Specialist with Cushman & Wakefield | PICOR, represented the landlord, and Lucia Hedke with Jones Lang LaSalle Brokerage, Inc. represented the tenant.
INDUSTRIAL – 1665 E. 18TH ST., TUCSON, AZ 85719, CENTRAL SUBMARKET
Vasquez Office Solutions, Inc. renewed its lease with SBC Investors, LLC for 3,030 square feet of industrial space at Tucson Tech Park, 1665 E. 18th St., Suite 109, in Tucson. Andrew Keim, Industrial Specialist, and Kameron Norwood, Investment Sales & Leasing Specialist with Cushman & Wakefield | PICOR, represented the landlord.
INDUSTRIAL – 4500 E. SPEEDWAY BLVD., TUCSON, AZ 85712, NORTHEAST SUBMARKET
Always Open & Shut Garage Door Service LLC renewed its lease with Pegasus Tucson Owner, LLC for 1,200 square feet of industrial space at Midway Business Park, 4500 E. Speedway Blvd., in Tucson. Paul Hooker, SIOR, Principal, and Andrew Keim, Industrial Specialists with Cushman & Wakefield | PICOR, represented the landlord.
RETAIL – 10235 E. OLD VAIL RD., TUCSON, AZ 85747, SOUTHEAST SUBMARKET
Align It! LLC renewed its lease with Prince Road Associates, LLC for 1,200 square feet of retail space at Las Plazas at Old Vail, 10235 E. Old Vail Rd., Suite 145, in Tucson. Dave Hammack, Principal, Retail Specialist with Cushman & Wakefield | PICOR, represented the landlord.
INDUSTRIAL – 2410 W. RUTHRAUFF RD., TUCSON, AZ 85705, CENTRAL SUBMARKET
SCS Engineers renewed its lease with Pegasus Tucson Owner, LLC for 192 square feet of industrial space at Ruthrauff Commerce Center, 2410 W. Ruthrauff Rd., Suite 110-Q, in Tucson. Paul Hooker, SIOR, Principal, and Andrew Keim, Industrial Specialists with Cushman & Wakefield | PICOR, represented the landlord.
